newsitem.title: USA: Catalina Lighting to appeal Browder verdict.
newsitem.headline: Catalina Lighting to appeal Browder verdict.

text.p: Catalina Lighting Inc. Thursday said it would appeal the verdict returned against the lighting products company in a lawsuit by its former president, John Browder.

Browder, who became president of Catalina in August 1989, sued the company for terminating his employment contract in April 1991. He was awarded $1.1 million for past salary and $400,000 for stock options.
The Miami-based company said it thought the verdict was "contrary to the weight of the evidence," and that it planned to seek a new trial.
Catalina makes and distributes home and office lighting and employs 3,000 people throughout the United States, Canada and Southeast Asia.
Its stock fell 25 cents to $3.75 on the New York Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
